source_review.notes: Checked all twelve structured primary references. Current Kubernetes documentation supports ConfigMap non-confidential purpose, data forms, namespace/size bounds, immutable objects, environment snapshots, eventual volume projection, and the subPath exception; Secret representation, types, limits, selective delivery, default backing-store warning, indirect pod authority, least privilege, projected service-account tokens, RBAC, and encryption-at-rest migration/rotation. Current Secrets Store CSI Driver documentation supports pod-volume/provider flow, optional rotation, application reload responsibility, native-Secret synchronization as an additional copy, and consumer-dependent sync lifecycle. The chapter does not treat API writes, projection, CSI health, encryption configuration, or source rotation as proof of process activation, downstream acceptance, or end-to-end confidentiality.
